lines.li: [them] {SITUATIONPLACE} is a proper town now, and our people are proud of it.
[us] We knew it in its first year.
[them,their:tribal] So the elders say, and the elders remember everything about that year.
[them] So the families there say, they still talk about that first year.

ColonyCouncil.OutsiderTalkDef.heard: {SITUATIONPLACE} of {PEOPLE} has grown into a town.

lines.li: [them] They mean to hold a first market at {SITUATIONPLACE}, a proper one with stalls.
[us] We might go.
[them,role:trader] Go early, the best stalls go to whoever gets there first.
[them] Go, it isn't every year a town has its first.
[them] The families at {SITUATIONPLACE} have been arguing about what to call the place.
[us] It has a name.
[them] It had a camp's name, and now they want a town's.
[them,their:tribal] {TOWN} was a few lean-tos once, and now it has a great hall.
[them,their:medieval] {TOWN} was a steading once, and now it has a wall the whole way round.
[them,their:hightech] {TOWN} has its charter now, and a council that meets on time, mostly.
[them] {TOWN} was a settlers' camp not long ago, and now it's a town with a market.
[us] We remember the camp.
[them] So do we, and who was there with us in that first year.

ColonyCouncil.OutsiderTalkDef.heard: {TOWN} has grown from a settlers' steading into a town.

lines.li: [them] {TOWN} is a town now, and it doesn't need anyone looking out for it.
[us] Good for {TOWN}.
[them] The fuss at home about the town that grew near you has finally died down.
[us] It earned some fuss.
[them] It did, but there's only so much anyone can say about a market square.
[them] {SITUATION} is on the road to your gate, they say, with no weapon drawn.
[us] What does he want?
[them] To ask your colony for something, and that's all he's told anyone.
[us] We'll hear him out.
[them] Good, that's all he's asking for, as far as I know.

ColonyCouncil.OutsiderTalkDef.heard: The warlord's son is on his way to the colony's gate.

lines.li: [them] The old ones say a son who walks unarmed to his enemy's gate is brave or a fool.
[us] Which is he?
[them] We'll know when he walks back.
[them] You'll have {SITUATION} at your gate before long.
[us] We know.
[them] {SITUATION} is on the run, and the road he's on leads past your gate.
[us] Who's after him?
[them] Whoever brought the warlord down, and they don't seem finished.
[us] And what do your people say?
[them,tone:warm|tone:good] That he's done nothing yet, whatever his blood.
[them] That it's none of our business, mostly.
[them] Whoever takes in {SITUATION} takes in his enemies too, remember that.
[us] We'll remember.
[them,their:lowtech] {SITUATION} has a few spears left and nowhere to point them.
[them] {SITUATION} has a few fighters left and no war to spend them on.
[us] What will he do?
[them] Hire on with whoever will feed them, I'd guess, and that might be you.
[them] People at home still talk about the warlord's son and your colony.
[us] Kindly?
[them] Depends who you ask, and how much they've had to drink.
